entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: A non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: Web3D Consortium X3D Working Group
entities.note: The primary working group responsible for advancing the X3D specification.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: X3D XML
entities.note: The XML encoding of the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D JSON
entities.note: The JSON encoding of the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D ClassicVRML
entities.note: The classic text-based encoding of the X3D standard, derived from VRML97.

entities.name: X3D Python
entities.note: The Python language binding for the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D Java
entities.note: The Java language binding for the X3D standard.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: The GL Transmission Format, often converted to or from X3D.

entities.name: USD
entities.note: Universal Scene Description, a 3D format often targeted for conversion.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: An open-source authoring tool for X3D scenes developed by the Naval Postgraduate School.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A popular open-source 3D creation suite.

entities.name: Blender X3D Exporter
entities.note: An add-on for Blender to export models into the X3D format.

entities.name: Aopt
entities.note: A command-line tool for optimizing and converting 3D models, part of InstantReality.

entities.name: InstantReality
entities.note: A high-performance Mixed Reality system that includes the Aopt tool.

entities.name: MeshLab
entities.note: An open-source system for processing and editing 3D triangular meshes, which supports X3D import/export.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: An open-source X3D editor designed primarily for Linux.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer and converter for X3D and VRML models based on the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: X3D Validator
entities.note: A comprehensive online suite for validating X3D files against standard rules.

entities.name: X3D Schematron
entities.note: A set of Schematron rules for validating X3D XML documents.

entities.name: X3D XML Schema
entities.note: The official W3C XML Schema (XSD) for validating X3D XML documents.

entities.name: x3d-tidy
entities.note: A command-line tool and library for checking and formatting X3D files.

entities.name: X3DPSAIL
entities.note: Python Scene Authoring Interface Library for X3D.

entities.name: X3DJSAIL
entities.note: Java Scene Authoring Interface Library for X3D.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL-based X3D and VRML player for web browsers.

entities.name: X3DJSONLD
entities.note: A tool and library for loading and converting X3D JSON files.

entities.name: X3DUOM
entities.note: X3D Unified Object Model, an XML-based representation of the X3D standard used to generate language bindings.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key contributor to the Web3D Consortium and developer of X3D-Edit, X3DPSAIL, and X3DJSAIL.

entities.name: John Carlson
entities.note: A key contributor to X3D JSON encoding and developer of X3DJSONLD.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: The primary developer of the Castle Game Engine and view3dscene.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: The primary developer of X_ITE, Titania, and x3d-tidy.
